on_screen_text.text: We can't let him do this !!
TRUMP ANSWERS QUESTIONS FROM F&F VIEWERS
Ending the U.S. Department of Education: What it would mean and why Trump and Project 2025 want it

NEA NEWS
How Project 2025 Would Devastate Public Education
The 900-page blueprint for a second Trump presidency would gut federal education funding, sanction discrimination against LGBTQ+ students, divert taxpayer funds to private schools, and codify book bans and classroom censorship on a national level. That's just the beginning.

STRIPPING SUPPORT FOR THE MOST VULNERABLE STUDENTS
Since 1965, Title I has provided critical financial help to high-poverty schools and districts. Project 2025 plans to eliminate Title I funding entirely. In its place, states will receive no-strings-attached block grants with zero regulations or oversight.
Under this plan, already tight education budgets will be further strained, undermining the academic outcomes of 2.8 million of the nation's most vulnerable students.

spoken_summary: Donald Trump states, "I'm going to take the Department of Education, close it. I'm going to close it."
audio_music: The video features dialogue from Donald Trump, followed by a series of dramatic, deep 'boom' sound effects that punctuate the appearance of each news article screenshot, creating an ominous and alarming tone.
editing_pacing: The video starts with a live-action clip and then transitions into a slideshow of three static screenshots. The pacing is deliberate, holding on each screenshot to allow for reading.
central_claim: Donald Trump intends to eliminate the U.S. Department of Education, a move that, according to Project 2025 plans, would devastate public education by cutting federal funding and support for vulnerable students.
intended_effect: To alarm viewers about the potential negative consequences of Donald Trump's and Project 2025's education policies and to motivate opposition to them.
